description: This class defines the ModuleNode, which represents a module in the PCB design hierarchy, extending PcbNode. It manages PCB module parameters such as pads and reference points, and provides methods for accessing these properties and determining connections.

classes.name: ModuleNode
classes.description: Represents a PCB module node with pads, position, and reference information. Supports connection checks and string representation.

methods.name: ModuleNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModuleNode with a name, index, and list of children components, and sets up pads, position, and reference data.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Returns the reference string of the module.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the module's reference and number of pads.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if any pad in this module is connected to the given PointNode, considering the module's position offset.
